🔍 Worker QR Code Test Page

Scan these QR codes with your app to test the worker assignment flow

📱 How to Test:

  1. Open your app in a browser (npm run dev)
  2. Switch to the "Hire" tab
  3. Click the scan button to activate the camera
  4. Point your device camera at one of the QR codes below
  5. The app will scan and show the worker's profile
  6. Assign them to a project!
